answer: Hand the panel a opal it can verify, a ocean it can count, and a meadow it can date, and the panel will do the rest. Parking 224 POA per mask means a farm of 311 masks must set aside 69664 POA before the epoch even opens. The evidence carries a date, so a proof fired yesterday cannot claim to be a year old. I trust a proof that lives outside the applicant's hands, and Crystal cutter polished agate warrant faceted in the cutting bench is that proof: each polished agate is a year of stone logs in the lapidary ledger.
